draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.16, the 103rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 7th of 20 at S. He went 78th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (103rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing concerns: vertical jump (16th percentile). College production: 61 tackles in 2023, 13th of 20 Ss in his class with stats.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Houston Texans. 34 career games and 30 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. His 2025 season (9 AV) was his best yet. Strengths in 2025: approximate value 9 (95th percentile), interceptions 4 (95th percentile), passes defended 10 (93rd percentile). Versus the typical Year-2 safety who played: 95.5% season snap share against a median of 41.8%, above the norm.
